# Exotic World Motor Cars (concept by Kerblabs)

> Luxury and exotic dealer and consignment store in Addison, Texas (Dallas area). Facts from exoticworldmotorcars.com. This is a free concept, not their official site.

- Address: 4570 Westgrove Drive, Addison, TX 75001
- Phone: 214-422-6539
- Hours: Monday to Saturday 10:30 AM to 4:00 PM; closed Sunday
- Contact form: https://exoticworldmotorcars.com/sendcomments
- Email: none published

## Services
- Buy luxury and exotic vehicles
- Sell and trade luxury and exotic vehicles
- Consignment (their site: DFW's number one consignment store for luxury and exotic vehicles)

## Marques listed on their site
Lamborghini, Ferrari, McLaren, Porsche, Maserati, Mercedes-Benz, Bentley

## FAQ
- Where? 4570 Westgrove Drive, Addison, TX 75001.
- Hours? Mon-Sat 10:30 AM to 4:00 PM, closed Sunday.
- Consignment? Yes, per their site; they also buy, sell and trade.
- Prices? Per-vehicle prices are on their live inventory pages, not in this concept.
